newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady except firmer heating.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady except firmer heating.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday, traders said.
Spot gasoline prices were about steady but traders said the market was beginning to show a softer undertone with recently supportive trade house hedging absent.
Naphtha prices were steady to softer in quiet trade. Traders said business was restricted to end-user top-up buying interest and the market was still waiting a seasonal boost from gasoline.

Heating oil was stronger after a German DIN cargo traded on Thursday at April Brent +$6.50 a tonne. Barges made modest gains to trade at April Brent -75 cents and -50 cents. German diesel barges were talked around April +$13/14.
Fuel oil barges edged up $1 or so, but many dealers thought the gain was a price bubble waiting to burst. Cargoes were unchanged.
